سررن (form I)
# سَرَرْنَ (sararna) /sa.rar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of سَرَّ (sarra)
# سُرِرْنَ (surirna) /su.rir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of سَرَّ (sarra) and سُرَّ (surra)
# سَرِرْنَ (sarirna) /sa.rir.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of سَرَّ (sarra)
